description: This file implements a TUIO input provider for the Kivy framework, handling TUIO protocol messages for touch and fiducial tracking, including classes for different TUIO object types and registration mechanisms.

classes.name: TuioMotionEventProvider
classes.description: Provides TUIO protocol handling, socket communication, and event dispatching for touch and fiducial data.

classes.name: TuioMotionEvent
classes.description: Base class for TUIO motion events, supporting multiple profiles such as position, angle, velocity, and acceleration.

classes.name: Tuio2dCurMotionEvent
classes.description: Represents a 2D cursor TUIO event with depack method for parsing args.

classes.name: Tuio2dObjMotionEvent
classes.description: Represents a 2D object TUIO event with depack method for parsing args.

classes.name: Tuio2dBlbMotionEvent
classes.description: Represents a 2D blob TUIO object with depack method for parsing args.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new OSC path to handle with a specific class.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a path to stop handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a touch event instance based on the OSC path.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the TUIO socket server and binds handlers.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Processes queued TUIO events and dispatches them.

methods.name: _osc_tuio_cb
methods.description: Callback for OSC messages, enqueues events.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Processes a single TUIO event and updates touches accordingly.

methods.name: depack
methods.description: Parses args to populate the TUIO event object.
